title: LiteCoder-Terminal: Scaling Long-Horizon Terminal Environments for Learning Language Agents
authors_zh: Peng, Xiaoxuan、Zhang, Kaiqi、Lu, Xinyu、Cao, Boxi、Lu, Yaojie、Lin, Hongyu、Han, Xianpei、Sun, Le
paper_type_zh: 开放后训练数据集与构造研究
best_for_zh: 覆盖 4B 到 32B 的终端代理监督微调
one_line: LiteCoder scales terminal environments and collects 11,255 verified conversations that preserve the entire instruction-reasoning-command-observation sequence.
LiteCoder 把终端监督数据从不足千条扩展到 11255 条完整轨迹，保留指令、推理、命令和工具观察。
why: Small terminal datasets provide too few long-horizon successes to study how task diversity and environment scale affect language agents.
inclusion_reason: The central contribution releases reusable serialized targets for terminal-agent SFT from 4B to 32B; records name the authoring mechanism and the selection signal.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Small terminal datasets provide too few long-horizon successes to study how task diversity and environment scale affect language agents.

LiteCoder scales terminal environments and collects 11,255 verified conversations that preserve the entire instruction-reasoning-command-observation sequence. The decision boundary is whether a serialized training record survives environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks; the central artifact is data consumed by terminal-agent SFT from 4B to 32B, not a model-only release.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2605.29559; arXiv preprint; data object LiteCoder-SFT-Terminal with 11,255 complete terminal-agent trajectories; evaluation surface The 32B variant reports 29.06%, 18.54%, and 34.00% pass@1 on three terminal benchmark settings; the paper also studies 4B-to-32B scaling.; collection note: full paper, official README, license, schema, and an actual public record checked on 2026-07-27.

小型终端数据缺少足够的长程成功轨迹，难以研究任务多样性和环境规模的作用。

该流程扩展终端环境并收集 11255 条经验证对话，完整保留指令、推理、命令和观察。 判定边界是记录能否通过环境成功、回放验证、难度过滤和轨迹质量检查并成为覆盖 4B 到 32B 的终端代理监督微调的输入；中心产物是训练数据，而不是只发布模型。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2605.29559；来源状态为arXiv 预印本；数据对象是 LiteCoder-SFT-Terminal，规模为11255 条完整终端代理轨迹；评估锚点为32B 模型在三个终端评测设置上的一次通过率分别为 29.06%、18.54% 和 34.00%，论文还比较了 4B 到 32B 的规模。；已于 2026-07-27 阅读全文、官方说明、许可、字段和一条公开实际记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LiteCoder scales terminal environments and collects 11,255 verified conversations that preserve the entire instruction-reasoning-command-observation sequence. Relative to sub-1K terminal SFT collections, it makes trajectory id and ordered human/assistant/tool conversation turns the reusable target and uses environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks as the feedback contract, so Track 01 is the correct category.

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: LiteCoder-SFT-Terminal Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lite-Coder/LiteCoder-Terminal-SFT Scale: 11,255 complete terminal-agent trajectories Record form: trajectory id and ordered human/assistant/tool conversation turns File / storage format: Parquet conversation records Domains / languages: terminal coding, shell operations, software engineering, and long-horizon tool use Construction and filtering: strong agents execute tasks and serialize reasoning, commands, and tool observations; environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks License / access constraints: MIT Intended use: terminal-agent SFT from 4B to 32B

该流程扩展终端环境并收集 11255 条经验证对话，完整保留指令、推理、命令和观察。 相比规模不足 1000 条的终端监督微调数据集，本文把轨迹编号以及有序的人类、助手和工具对话轮次作为可复用目标，并以环境成功、回放验证、难度过滤和轨迹质量检查作为反馈契约，因此应归入 Track 01。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: scaled terminal environments and generated task instances. Operation: Normalize prompts, media, provenance, and reference fields into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject missing task inputs, source identifiers, or access terms.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: Each normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: strong agents execute tasks and serialize reasoning, commands, and tool observations. Output and transition: A serialized response, reasoning trace, or tool trajectory advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to the prompt, teacher, or source evidence.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and the paper's correctness metadata. Operation: Apply environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks. Output and transition: Passing records form 11,255 complete terminal-agent trajectories stored as Parquet conversation records. Check / stop rule: Reject failures; do not treat final-answer agreement as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The versioned release and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for terminal-agent SFT from 4B to 32B and compare with sub-1K terminal SFT collections. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the controlled evidence reported by the paper. Check / stop rule: Pin data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, and harness; stop claims at the evaluated domains.

Reproducibility requires the official data revision, generation settings, verifier/tool versions, random seeds, split, base model, and evaluation harness. Unreported budgets remain unknown.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：扩展后的终端环境与合成任务实例。 操作：统一题目、媒体、来源和参考字段，形成候选记录。 输出及流转：可审计候选进入目标生成阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少任务输入、来源标识或使用条款时拒绝。

步骤 2——写入可复用目标。 输入：标准化候选及其来源证据。 操作：强代理执行任务并序列化推理、命令和工具观察。 输出及流转：序列化回答、推理过程或工具轨迹进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：目标无法对应题目、生成者或来源证据时停止。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成目标和论文定义的正确性信息。 操作：执行环境成功、回放验证、难度过滤和轨迹质量检查。 输出及流转：通过的记录组成官方发布并按数据页格式保存。 检查与停止规则：失败记录被拒绝；最终答案一致不代表每个中间步骤正确。

步骤 4——训练并评估消费者。 输入：固定版本的数据与论文基础模型。 操作：用于覆盖 4B 到 32B 的终端代理监督微调，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的消费者和论文报告的受控证据。 检查与停止规则：固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型和评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

复现还需固定数据版本、生成设置、验证器或工具版本、随机种子、切分、基础模型和评测器；未披露预算保持未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Experiment 1: The 32B variant reports 29.06%, 18.54%, and 34.00% pass@1 on three terminal benchmark settings; the paper also studies 4B-to-32B scaling.

Experiment 2: The released artifact contains 11,255 complete terminal-agent trajectories; on 2026-07-27 the official Hub page exposed an actual record with fields trajectory id and ordered human/assistant/tool conversation turns and reported 559 downloads. Artifact use does not by itself validate the paper's causal claim.

实验 1：32B 模型在三个终端评测设置上的一次通过率分别为 29.06%、18.54% 和 34.00%，论文还比较了 4B 到 32B 的规模。

实验 2：官方发布规模为11255 条完整终端代理轨迹。2026-07-27 的数据页可读取含轨迹编号以及有序的人类、助手和工具对话轮次的实际记录并显示 559 次下载；使用量不能代替因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest prior baseline is sub-1K terminal SFT collections. The paper changes the reusable object by making trajectory id and ordered human/assistant/tool conversation turns explicit and coupling it to environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks. This is a direction signal because another team can train the stated consumer from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是规模不足 1000 条的终端监督微调数据集。真正变化是把轨迹编号以及有序的人类、助手和工具对话轮次显式化，并与环境成功、回放验证、难度过滤和轨迹质量检查绑定。另一团队可以直接用公开记录训练所述消费者，因此这是数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. successful trajectories omit many recovery failures.
  2. The published checks do not establish that every intermediate reasoning step is correct or causally necessary.
  3. Reuse must preserve MIT and any upstream media or source-data terms.

1. 成功轨迹遗漏了许多恢复失败过程；基准环境也简化了权限、网络和持久状态。
  2. 已公开检查不能证明每个中间推理步骤都正确或不可替代。
  3. 复用必须保留官方许可，并继续遵守所有上游媒体或来源数据条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the dataset to build or ablate terminal-agent SFT from 4B to 32B; preserve provenance and compare a fixed backbone before attributing gains to the traces.
  • Audit a stratified sample against environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks. The output should be a versioned keep/reject ledger, not only a benchmark score.

• 可用该数据构建或消融覆盖 4B 到 32B 的终端代理监督微调；保留来源并固定骨干后，才能把收益归因于轨迹。
  • 按来源和难度分层抽样，依据环境成功、回放验证、难度过滤和轨迹质量检查复核。输出应是带版本的保留与拒绝台账，而不只是基准分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: LiteCoder scales terminal environments and collects 11,255 verified conversations that preserve the entire instruction-reasoning-command-observation sequence.
  • Data object: trajectory id and ordered human/assistant/tool conversation turns.
  • Author and selector: strong agents execute tasks and serialize reasoning, commands, and tool observations; selection uses environment success, replay validation, difficulty filtering, and trajectory quality checks.
  • Evidence anchor: The 32B variant reports 29.06%, 18.54%, and 34.00% pass@1 on three terminal benchmark settings; the paper also studies 4B-to-32B scaling.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for terminal-agent SFT from 4B to 32B; first audit successful trajectories omit many recovery failures, and benchmark environments simplify permissions, networking, and persistent state.

• 定位：LiteCoder 把终端监督数据从不足千条扩展到 11255 条完整轨迹，保留指令、推理、命令和工具观察。
  • 数据对象：轨迹编号以及有序的人类、助手和工具对话轮次。
  • 生成与选择：强代理执行任务并序列化推理、命令和工具观察；依据环境成功、回放验证、难度过滤和轨迹质量检查筛选。
  • 证据锚点：32B 模型在三个终端评测设置上的一次通过率分别为 29.06%、18.54% 和 34.00%，论文还比较了 4B 到 32B 的规模。
  • 复用决定：适合覆盖 4B 到 32B 的终端代理监督微调；首先审计中间步骤、来源和许可。
